description: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's China-mainland offer, served from the China (Beijing) region with a region-specific model catalogue, API key, endpoint, and CNY pricing.
residency_notes: The China-mainland deployment scope executes inference only in China mainland and stores static data in the selected region. This offer uses China (Beijing), region ID cn-beijing. Alibaba Cloud states that each region has an independent endpoint, API key, and model list that cannot be mixed across regions.
prompt_training_notes: Alibaba Cloud says pay-as-you-go Model Studio API data is not used for model training. It also says data generated by model and application calls is stored where required by applicable laws, so this is not a Zero Data Retention offer.
regional_pricing_notes: China (Beijing) list prices are published in CNY and differ from Alibaba Cloud's international regional offers. MiniMax/MiniMax-M2.7 is CNY 2.10 per million input tokens, CNY 8.40 per million output tokens, and cached input is billed at 20% of the standard input price.

sources.notes: Official region IDs, endpoints, region isolation, and China-mainland execution and storage scope.
Official OpenAI-compatible route and exact MiniMax/MiniMax-M2.7 model ID and capabilities.
Official China (Beijing) MiniMax pricing in CNY.
Official training-use and call-data storage statements.

verification.notes: Verified as the distinct Alibaba Cloud Model Studio China (Beijing) offer. The single catalogued MiniMax route, regional endpoint, CNY pricing, region isolation, and data-policy statements were checked against Alibaba Cloud primary documentation; Phaseo routing remains intentionally disabled.
